authors.full_name: National Statistics Office (example), Food security unit

document_description.abstract: Annual report on food security, combining the prevalence of undernourishment series with household budget survey results on food expenditure and dietary diversity. The 2025 edition reports a decline in undernourishment from 8.4 percent in 2022 to 7.6 percent in 2024 and presents district-level estimates for the first time, with their margins of error.
